sloka: विभजाम ततः सर्वा विवादो मे न रोचते ।पेयमानीयतां क्षिप्रं माल्यं च विविधं बहु ।। ५.२२.३९।।।।
transliteration: vibhajāma tataḥ sarvā vivādo me na rocate ।peyamānīyatāṁ kṣipraṁ mālyaṁ ca vividhaṁ bahu ।। 5.22.39।।।।

translations.english: An ogress called Dhanyamalini at once approached the tenheaded Ravana and embracing him, said:.
